scope: Read-only geometry, room-detail clipping, kitchen/window fit, bathroom mirror and navigation audit
baseline: R16 working tree after initial three geometry fixes, before extended audit corrections

findings.evidence: Bathroom focus hides rear cladding x=+0.5032 in standard mode (opposite rear piece in mirrored mode), because side-wall culling tests only x sign.
findings.fix: Identify only lateral skins as candidates for the cutaway; retain rear pieces.

findings.evidence: T2 kitchen bounds x=-3.055..-2.305,z=-3.94..-1.46; all six bathroom cladding pieces outside these bounds remain visible with zero clipping planes.
findings.fix: Hide bathSkin while kitchen detail is active, or scope clipping exemptions by room.

findings.evidence: T2 kitchen-01 ray(-4,1.8,-2.65)->+X hits glass x=-3.071, then solid cupboard back x=-2.98 and upper door x=-2.676. Upper row overlaps source window heights and position.
findings.affected: 17 supported layout/kitchen combinations, seven references with uppers: kitchen-01,03,04,05,08,11,13; both bathroom orientations.
findings.fix: Adapt only upper modules intersecting known aperture; preserve source window and disclose adaptation.

findings.evidence: T4 A linear run blocks424mm of760mm door. Existing camera at x=-0.7464 can cross only in z=-0.456..-0.440. Coarse80mm BFS fails, refined20/10mm succeeds: tight bottleneck, not inaccessible.
findings.fix: Verified candidate kitchenZ=b.z1+0.40, compact length1.60: all five rooms reachable for standard/mirrored bathroom on40mm grid. Simply shifting1.80m run to b.z1+0.24 makes mirrored WC unreachable.

findings.evidence: bathroom-02 curved shower centre x=-0.2014 remains equal in standard and mirrored; basin correctly changes -0.4764 to+0.4764. Shower assembly never reads state.bathroom despite UI opposite-side equipment promise.
findings.fix: Mirror complete shower assembly locally on X in mirrored mode, retaining motion parent and plan footprint.

findings.evidence: Global fittings button is not guarded during walk. Open upper leaf spans y1.522..2.158; point(-2.15049,1.84,-1.575998) lies in leaf but navigation accepts x/z because only closed plan footprints contribute.
findings.fix: Stop walk before global fittings toggle, or include dynamic panel colliders.

navigation.roomsReachable: All combinations, with finer-grid refinement needed for T4 A linear bottleneck.
